name: stasis
title: Stasis
description: Pause and resume running apps through the Stasis menu bar utility.
author: marstaj

commands.name: apps
commands.title: Pause / Resume Apps
commands.description: List running apps and pause or resume them in place.

commands.name: pause-all
commands.title: Pause All Except Front App
commands.description: Pause every app except the one in front.

commands.name: pause-all-including-front
commands.title: Pause All Apps
commands.description: Pause every app, including the one in front.

commands.name: resume-all
commands.title: Resume All Apps
commands.description: Resume every paused, partially paused or not-responding app.
